name: 临场编排剧本（Figure It Out）
description_zh: 当没有更窄的剧本适用时，自己设计一个可审计的工作流：按任务规模伸缩严格度、跑科学方法假设循环、留下人能事后审计的决策轨迹。
description_en: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work a human reviews after stepping away. Scales rigor to the task, runs a hypothesis loop, and logs decisions. Use for /figure-it-out or 'figure it out'.
